metadata.name: Jiminy Guide Flow Map
metadata.description: Tests comprehension of the T1-encoded Jiminy guidance flow, covering trigger mechanism, timeout, encoding tiers, parallel source queries, and effectiveness tracking.
metadata.author: reh3376

questions.question: What triggers the Jiminy guide flow?
What is the timeout for the guide orchestration?
What are the three J17 encoding tiers and their approximate token sizes?
questions.answer: T1: coded ~15 tokens (80% traffic), T2: telegraphic ~50-100 tokens (15%), T3: full NL ~200+ tokens (5%)

questions.question: What parallel sources does the guide query?
questions.answer: Constraints from graph (cns.Suggest), corrections via vector search, CONTRADICTS edges, frontier nodes (knowledge gaps), and per-session trust scoring

questions.question: What does jim.Effectiveness track?
questions.answer: Guidance_id for feedback correlation (whether guidance was followed)

profiles.rationale: Initial profile — balanced weights, comprehension-dominant for Jiminy injection use case
